snippet.title: lunr.rdio.taxi - Official Demo Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase May 2026
snippet.description:
lunr.rdio.taxi blends drifting and rhythm into an exhilarating spacetime 'DRIFTHM' adventure! Slide and boost your way through the solar system to the beat of Brazil's best DJs and earn big as an interplanetary taxi pilot trying to pay an infinite debt in this hypercapitalistic BrazaFunk future.
lunr.rdio.taxi will be available on PC, and a demo is out now on Steam.
